stories.title: Show amounts to the cent, and drop expired offers as they expire
stories.markdown:
# Show amounts to the cent, and drop expired offers as they expire

Borrowers see exact amounts everywhere, and never try to accept an offer that has just expired.

## What changes

- Every amount (payments, fees, totals) shows in the loan's currency, to the cent.
- When an offer expires while a borrower has the offers list open, it leaves the list on its own, without a reload.

## Acceptance criteria

- **R-p4c.** Amounts are shown in the loan's currency, to the cent, everywhere.
- An offer that expires disappears from an open list within a few seconds.
- Nothing else on the list moves or reloads when it goes.

## For developers

- The server sends `offer-expired` down the page's live channel; the list reloads on it.
